title: scenarios: a thrown live ask is recorded so replay counts it, and a wrongly cased skill file is refused clearly
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic). The maintainer set who files this epic's cards, in this session's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「你应该负责立卡，对方只是派发处理」. The gap was reported to this session by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6948819963, item 2); the filer did not re-read the code behind it. Source: the contract-review delta on PR #34808 (#34687), 6948332112.

## Why

Two ways the ask runner can report a better or a stranger result than what happened: a failed run that disappears on replay, and a crash in place of a refusal.

## Evidence

- Per the report: when a live ask throws, `RecordingDriver` records no turn; on replay the counted failure becomes "not measured" and a row can rise from 4/5 live to 4/4.
- Per the report: the `SKILL.md` match is case-sensitive; on a case-insensitive filesystem a top-level `skill.md` ends in a TypeError.

## Scope

- A thrown ask is recorded as a turn that failed, and replays as that failure.
- A skills directory whose skill file is not spelled `SKILL.md` is refused with a sentence naming the file.

## Done when

- A recording with one thrown ask replays to the same row it showed live; the wrongly cased file gets the refusal.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34687 (PR #34808).
